description: Reads one stored receipt and GETs its public target_url. The verdict is verified, not_found, mismatch, or unverifiable, with source, as_of, ttl, version, and label tested or unknown. verified requires a full-body sha256, an exact text/plain body of 16 to 200 characters, or an exact JSON scalar at a dotted path. HTTP 404 and 410 are not_found. A finished comparison that fails is mismatch. Private, loopback, link-local, and metadata addresses, including after DNS and redirects, plus timeouts, oversized bodies, and any other uncertainty, are unverifiable.
name: verify_claim
